description: Updates a user's role on a specific Trello board using board and membership IDs, with optional member fields in the response.

inputSchema.description: Updates a specific Trello board membership.

idBoard.description: Unique identifier of the Trello board.
idBoard.title: Id Board

idMembership.description: Unique identifier of the membership to be updated.
idMembership.title: Id Membership

member_fields.description: Fields for the member to include in the response. Use 'all' or a comma-separated list (e.g., avatarHash, bio, fullName).
member_fields.title: Member Fields

type.description: New role for the member on the board, determining their permissions. Must be 'admin', 'normal', or 'observer'.
type.title: Type

inputSchema.title: UpdateBoardMembershipRequest

name: update_board_membership

Member.description: Nested member object containing details about the member.

avatarHash.description: Hash of the member's avatar image
avatarHash.title: Avatar Hash

avatarUrl.description: URL to the member's avatar image
avatarUrl.title: Avatar Url

bioData.description: Structured biography data of the member
bioData.title: Bio Data

confirmed.description: Whether the member's account has been confirmed
confirmed.title: Confirmed

products.description: List of Trello products the member has access to
products.title: Products

url.description: URL to the member's Trello profile
url.title: Url

Member.title: Member

UpdateBoardMembershipResponse.description: Details of the updated board membership.

deactivated.description: Whether the membership has been deactivated
deactivated.title: Deactivated

id.description: Unique identifier of the board membership
id.title: Id

idMember.description: Unique identifier of the member who has this membership
idMember.title: Id Member

member.description: Nested member object containing details about the member. Included when member_fields parameter is used.
member.title: Member

memberType.description: Type of membership on the board. Valid values include 'admin', 'normal', and 'observer'
memberType.title: Member Type

unconfirmed.description: Whether the membership invitation has not yet been confirmed by the member
unconfirmed.title: Unconfirmed

UpdateBoardMembershipResponse.title: UpdateBoardMembershipResponse
